fn wechat_media::decode_sticker_archive | fn(bytes: &[u8], product: &str, ids: &[alloc::string::String]) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::sticker_archive::StickerArchive> | Decode a supported ZIP with exact product root, bounded expansion, regular files, unique paths, CRC verification and MD5/detail ordinal correspondence.
fn wechat_media::export_sticker_pack | fn(directory: &std::path::Path, pack_id: &str, name: &str, items: alloc::vec::Vec<wechat_media::sticker_export::StickerExportItem>, resume: bool) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::sticker_export::StickerExportIndex> | Export one selected pack as numbered GIFs plus index.json. Resumption checks product, ordered identities and checksums; unrelated files are never replaced.
fn wechat_media::inspect_image | fn(bytes: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::image::ImageInspection> | Inspect the retained source. For WXGF, dimensions describe its still preview; `frames` does not establish the source's animation frame count.
fn wechat_media::inspect_video_container | fn(input: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<&'static str> | Check the top-level movie boxes before invoking the MOV-family demuxer. Older QuickTime movies may omit `ftyp`; both layouts still need owned movie metadata and media bytes. This only checks container structure; callers must separately decode and validate streams before sending.
fn wechat_media::prepare_sticker | fn(input: &[u8], options: &wechat_media::stickers::StickerImageOptions, cancelled: impl core::ops::function::FnMut() -> anyhow::Result<()>) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::stickers::PreparedStickerImage> | Prepare a supported still image/GIF or a bounded MOV/MP4 video. Video timing and shape are probed first; shortening and resizing require caller choices. The resulting animation contains no audio and uses a 10 fps conversion policy.
fn wechat_media::prepare_sticker_image | fn(bytes: &[u8], options: &wechat_media::stickers::StickerImageOptions) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::stickers::PreparedStickerImage> | Convert a bounded still image or GIF into a validated sticker. Oversized dimensions require `fit`; duration/frame limits fail rather than silently trimming. Existing compliant GIFs are preserved byte-for-byte.
fn wechat_media::sticker_export_gif | fn(bytes: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<(alloc::vec::Vec<u8>, alloc::vec::Vec<alloc::string::String>)> | Convert an original to GIF for export. Valid GIFs retain their exact bytes.
fn wechat_media::sticker_preview | fn(bytes: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::stickers::StickerPreview> | Produce bounded visual input. WXGF currently supplies one decoded still; this does not claim that its full animation was watched or sampled.
fn wechat_media::wxgf_preview | fn(bytes: &[u8]) -> anyhow::Result<wechat_media::DecodedImage> | Decode one representative JPEG without changing the WXGF source. This is a still preview, not a reconstruction of source animation timing or alpha.

mod wechat_media | - | Bounded media inspection shared by native transport and official profiles. Inspection retains source bytes, including application trailers. Explicit sticker preparation returns a separately validated output and previews. WXGF inspection decodes a representative still only. Its animation timing, frame count and alpha semantics remain unknown; the original stays WXGF.

struct wechat_media::PreparedStickerImage | struct { public fields } | Validated GIF plus PNG images suitable for visual model input.
struct wechat_media::StickerArchive | struct { public fields } | Fully verified supported pack content. Membership is a separate operation.
struct wechat_media::StickerArchiveItem | struct { public fields } | One original and its paired thumbnail in canonical one-based order.
struct wechat_media::StickerExportEntry | struct { public fields } | One numbered output and its integrity/transformation record.
struct wechat_media::StickerExportIndex | struct { public fields } | Machine-readable index for exactly one pack, including partial outcomes.
struct wechat_media::StickerExportItem | struct { public fields } | One selected pack item, including a retrieval failure for partial exports.
struct wechat_media::StickerImageOptions | struct { public fields } | Explicit adjustments for image/GIF preparation.
struct wechat_media::StickerPreview | struct { public fields } | Visual images derived from an original without changing its format or timing.
struct wechat_media::StickerTrim | struct { public fields } | A segment requested by the caller, in milliseconds.
